{{Quote|We lost nearly half the crew getting the creature in there. The Jedi should have some trouble with it, too.|Onyx|<ref name="CW2">[[The Clone Wars 2|''The Clone Wars'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Blixus''' were large [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopods]] from an unknown [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of origin.

==Biology and appearance==
A horrific monstrosity coated with a half-shelled, articulated carapace, with hard [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]] covering its six pick-like [[Limb/Legends|legs]]. Its well-muscled underbelly concealed a ghastly gash of a mouth filled with sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], and a pair of pincer-tipped graspers. Its most terrifying feature, though, were the five sinewy tentacles that terminated in sucker-lined grasping pads.<ref name="SWEB" />

==History==
The blixus was a rare beast that was regarded as a prize by most collectors, as long as they were able to avoid the reach of its [[Death/Legends|deadly]] tentacles.<ref name="SWEB" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TCW11">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref> a proud [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] surrounded himself with a menagerie of «lesser» creatures to reinforce his superiority over other life-forms. His blixus was a proud addition to his exotic collection.<ref name="SWEB" />
{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Blixus.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Blixus in the second ''Slaves of the Republic'' comic]]
The creature that attacks the Republic forces is not named in the issue, but according to author Henry Gilroy it is called a blixus.<ref name="title">{{DHBoards|subdomain=www|url=Help/Boards/viewtopic.php?t=14579|thread=THE CLONE WARS #2 -- "Slave Traitors"|user=Randy Stradley|date=2008-10-16|time=11:47 am}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], one such creature was kept on the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] owned by Captain [[Onyx (individual)|Onyx]]. When the vessel was attacked by a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Onyx released the blixus to kill them. The creature managed to kill several clones, but was defeated by the Jedi. Separatist commander [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] also had a blixus on his ship, the [[Tecora/Legends|''Tecora'']]. Blixus could also withstand the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="CW2" />
